color.formula: out = srgb_to_linear(mix(ink, line(c), o)); line(c) = mix(mix(c, lineTint, lineTintMix), 0, lineDarken); c = T_AF_Palette_BC(uv) (sRGB values), o = T_AF_Palette_P(uv).a
color.note: mix(ink, line(c), o) is never lighter than line(c); ink classes keep hull lum <= 40 (o <= 0.4)

outline.model: inverted hull baked into every mesh (P7/R3): material slot 1 M_AF_Outline, unlit, opaque, default back-face culling (the hull's winding is flipped, so its far side draws the rim); same skin weights

formula: depth = TransformPosition(P, World->View).z  (= dot(P - CameraPosition, CameraForward))
wpo.meaning: the hull's far side = the body silhouette dilated by OutlinePx1080 * ViewSizeY / 1080 pixels in screen space (clip-space extrusion along the normalised projected normal)
wpo.mobileLow: WPO off: the baked width alone (hero 1.8 cm = 2.16 px at the default distance)

params.TanHalfFOV.y: ViewProperty 'Tan(0.5 x FieldOfView)'.y = tan(FOVx/2) * ViewSizeY / ViewSizeX

wpo.preview: kit.outline.set_preview_screen (Geometry Nodes, same formula per vertex)

rim.formula: alpha * smoothstep(band0, band1, (1 - max(N.V, 0))^power) * smoothstep(0, maskEdge, N.L)

details.cells: 4 x 4 cells of one tile: row 0 grass, 1 dirt, 2 stone, 3 camp (paint 5); column = variant - 1 (variants 1..3); column 3 (water) is transparent: lily pads are the instanced SM_Foliage_Plains_LilyPad_A/B meshes only (spec 6.1)
details.rule: own tile (nearest centre) h = tileHash(col, row, 7): h % 12 >= 6 -> variant 1 + h % 3; sample cell at frac(UV0 + 0.5) (tile-local 0..1); composite over the winning material only when it is the own tile's material (AF_Terrain _pattern_block own_var / own_m)

channels.g: the same field pre-offset for m = 1
channels.r: latNoise(u + .5, v + .5) * .5 + .5 (period 3) — transition wobble: score += 0.3 * (2r - 1) with u, v offset by (m * .37, -m * .61) per material m

noise.use: mobile / low quality: replaces the 12-sine analytic noise of AF_Terrain

plains.source: Data/terrain_styles.json themes.plains (same colours as the runtime Tile<i>* vectors)
transitions: per pixel: the 4 tiles round its tile corner, w = (1 - d^2)^2 (d = distance to the tile centre), normalised per material
score s = w_norm + rank * 0.025 + 0.3 * noise_m; winner t1, runner-up t2, delta = s1 - s2
coverage a = 1 if delta >= 0.025 else 0.5 + delta / 0.05 (crisp anti-aliased cel edge)
t1 liquid: shallow tint (1 - smoothstep(.5, .95, w1)) * .75 toward WaterShallow; foam WaterFoam where delta < .065: (1 - delta / .065)^.6 * .92
t2 liquid: bank WaterBank .7 * (1 - delta / .045) for delta < .045, then .25 * (1 - (delta - .045) / .055) up to .1
rank1 > rank2: lip (Tile<i>Lip, else base + 25 % toward #FFF2D6) at .75 for delta < .032
rank1 < rank2: dark edge #241A3A at .2 * (1 - delta / .055) for delta < .055
walls paint the dominant ground (grass), camp walls camp ground; vertex G (wall coverage) darkens x (.62,.66,.6) * .45; vertex B (skirt) * .86
plains.uv: UV0 = tile space (col, row; tile centre at integers); layer textures repeat every 3 tiles: sample at UV0 / 3, wrap, bilinear + mips (flat toon colour, no noise)

water.lilyPads: SM_Foliage_Plains_LilyPad_A/B on ~1 in 6 water tiles (game id lily_pad_plains)

channels.g: foam breakup noise: foam = smoothstep(.55, .62, shore + (g - .5) * .2)
channels.r: wave flecks (#A9E2EE x .7), scroll UV0/3 + t*(.05,.03)

units.axes: UE (X fwd, Y right, Z up)
